{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

duplicates = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicates)}")

# Check the sentinel value -999 in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Confirm assay_batch doesn't affect baseline (only final)
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check sample_seq: highest should be kept
print(f"Highest sample_seq per patient: {data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().describe()}")

# Check if any patient has more than one row
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
print(f"Patients with multiple rows: {patient_counts[patient_counts > 1].count()}")"}
